site_name: Former gas works site, north of Pier Road, Gillingham
evidence_slice: Medway Council's Regulation 19 Local Plan (2025) Site Allocations chapter states that site allocations direct future development and that each site has a unique Policies Map reference. Under Policy SA4 River Waterfront, Policies Map ID GN6 is the former gas works site north of Pier Road, Gillingham. The site-specific table records residential, older persons accommodation and convenience retail uses, capacity up to 500 homes, and delivery in plan-period years 1-5. The policy also identifies contamination remediation requirements for GN6 and requires its height relationship with the neighbouring Strand to avoid overbearing effects.
